title: X-ray Absorption Process
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the process of electron removal from inner shells for X-ray absorption.

title: UV and Visible Absorption
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately describe the transition of atomic electrons for ultraviolet and visible light absorption.

title: Near Infra-red Process
description: Essential Criteria: The student must specify the vibrational transitions in molecules for near infra-red absorption.

title: Far Infra-red Process
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain the rotational transitions in molecules for far infra-red absorption.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide clear and concise explanations for each absorption process.

title: Correct Terminology
description: Important Criteria: The student must use appropriate scientific terminology related to atomic and molecular transitions.

title: Missing Details
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid omitting key details about the energy levels involved in transitions.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure there are no sign errors in describing the transitions.
